confirmed.sentence: وتبلغ قيمة الشيكات الإجمالية 500 مليون دولار، وفقاً لورقة حقائق نشرها البيت الأبيض الخميس.
confirmed.quote: The refund payments — which would total about $500 million — come just weeks before the midterm elections, in which Democrats are favored to win back at least one chamber of Congress from Republicans.
confirmed.correction: The total of about $500 million is CNBC's own reporting and is not attributed to the White House fact sheet, which the source cites only for the 30-state eligibility.

confirmed.sentence: انتقد خبراء السياسة الصحية القرار ووصفوه بأنه محاولة لتشتيت الانتباه عن ارتفاع تكاليف الرعاية الصحية.
confirmed.quote: He said the policy is likely a form of "damage control" for the White House to distract from higher healthcare costs.
confirmed.correction: Only one expert, Jonathan Oberlander, said the policy is likely a form of damage control to distract from higher healthcare costs; this was his hedged view, not a characterization made by experts generally.

confirmed.sentence: المؤشر: انخفاض الاشتراكات في البورصة بحلول فبراير · القيمة: 3 ملايين (13%)
confirmed.quote: As of February, ACA marketplace enrollment had declined by about 3 million people, or 13%, from enrollment figures a year earlier, the Department of Health and Human Services said in June.
confirmed.correction: The decline was in ACA health insurance marketplace (exchange) enrollment, not on a stock exchange.
